hooks.name: Guard Sensitive File Writes
hooks.description: Prompts for confirmation before the agent writes to secret-bearing files like .env or credential stores.

action.command: $in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($in -match '\.env(\b|["'']|\\|/|$)' -or $in -match 'credentials' -or $in -match 'private\.pem' -or $in -match 'secret') { Write-Output '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This write targets a file that may contain secrets (.env, credentials, private keys). Confirm before proceeding."}}' }; exit 0
